title: Chinese tokenization support
body:
Hi,
I want to use both chinese search and vector search with bm25.How can i set properties tokenization?
It seems to not work when i set tokenization: "word"

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Hi @reporter we don't have a feature supporting Chinese tokenization right now but would be open to adding it. Would adding a `tokenization: "chinese"` option using https://github.com/go-ego/gse suit?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: thanks! I would try to add it by myself and expect your implement!

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
I want to use Japanese tokenization for BM25 and hybrid search.
I hope this feature will be implemented.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
> I want to use Japanese tokenization for BM25 and hybrid search. I hope this feature will be implemented.

I am using jieba to tokenize chinese texts and joining  splitted word with whitespace for now.
Like "你好朋友" -> "你好 朋友"，save this text and can use bm25. Because English tokenization is using whitespace

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Thank you!!
I will use your method as workaround.

However, save text with whitespace may increase the token of ChatGPT 3.5, so I still want Chinese, Japanese Tokenization feature.
My ideal is that weaviate run tokenization during only BM25 search to get answer.
I guess nobody accomplish hybrid search with Chinese and Japanese in Vector Database industory.
Support this feature will catch every Chinese and Japanese users!!

comments.author: participant3
comments.body:

comments.author: participant3
comments.body:
> 

do the whitespaces also be embedded by embedding model?
could this effect the search performance in vector seach aspect?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
whitespace will be embedded if your input text with whitespace.
In my method, raw text will be embbed and keyword with whitespace will be saved.
Like this:
raw_text = "xxxxx"
embed = embedding_model(raw_text) # saved for vector search 
keyword = " ".join(tokenizer(raw_text)) # saved for bm25 search

embed will be saved in vector property of my schema
keyword will be saved as text in my schema

if keyword and embed are in two fieldes, can you still use hybrid search?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
yep，like this
response = (
    client.query
    .get("JeopardyQuestion", ["question", "answer"])
    .with_hybrid(
        query="food",
        vector=vector
    )
    .with_limit(3)
    .do()
)
